## Description

Please describe the motivation behind this change and what problem it solves.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows project code formatting guidelines (`./gradlew spotlessCheck`)
- [ ] Tests have been added/updated to cover changes
- [ ] `./gradlew test` passes cleanly out-of-the-box
- [ ] Public Besu plugin API boundaries are preserved
- [ ] Documentation updated if applicable
